prompt:
Please turn the character in the attached image [Name: [Character Name]] into a comical wanted poster/arrest-style visual where they are being taken away for a strange crime, even though they probably aren't at fault.

Decide the charges randomly. Make the content light, fun, and comical.

The composition should be a pose standing in front of a height line, or the moment they are being lightly restrained. Additionally, place weird small items around them as "evidence." It can be two cuts (front and side) or a single image. Do not use real police or national marks; keep it completely fictional and humorous. Leave space to write additional charges later.

promptZh:
请将附图中的角色 [姓名：未知] 制作成一张搞笑风格的通缉令或逮捕现场视觉图，营造出“明明大概率没犯事，却因为某个离谱罪名被带走”的喜感氛围。

罪名请随机发挥，整体内容要轻松、有趣、充满喜剧效果。

构图方面，可以让角色站在身高标尺前拍照，或者定格在被轻轻制服的瞬间。此外，在周围散落一些奇奇怪怪的小物件作为“证物”。画面可以是两张分镜（正面和侧面），也可以是单张图。请勿使用现实中真实的警察标志或国家徽章，保持完全虚构的幽默风格。记得预留出后续添加罪名的空白区域。
